units.source_text: 此次吟诗，大约不是朝廷公式，乃家庭之事，故唱和之人不多。

en.t: This poetry gathering was probably not an official court ceremony, but a family affair, so there were not many people composing verses in response.

units.source_text: 但也许是作者当时忘记记录了。

en.t: But perhaps the author simply forgot to record it at the time.
